entries.title: Deterministic nested block-diagram tooling for standalone HTML
entries.question: How can a dense nested engineering diagram preserve fixed positions and orthogonal routing in self-contained HTML/SVG?
entries.scope: About 90 nodes, 190 typed edges, nested containers and author-controlled coordinates; ranking synthesis, not an implemented diagram.
entries.summary: Ranks layout-spec-to-SVG, JointJS, D2/TALA and maxGraph; contrasts fixed placement with auto-layout and flags TALA licensing.
